ISSUES_DESCRIPTION: Investigate failures that affect site delivery and use the source-owned recovery action.
ISSUE_QUEUE_DESCRIPTION: The queue is built from persisted publish and delivery facts.
DOMAINS_DESCRIPTION: Review verification and certificate readiness for active bindings.
STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: Review storage readiness and run an authoritative connection test.
RULES_DESCRIPTION: Preview the cross-workspace impact before applying a Hosting Continuity policy revision.
RULES_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: Current Hosting Continuity and suspension projections remain source-owned evidence.
ISSUE_RETRY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This issue is not eligible for retry.
ISSUE_HOSTING_ACTION_REQUIRED: This recovery action applies only to Hosting Continuity issues.
ISSUE_RESTORE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Restore is available after a canonical recovery fact is present.
ISSUE_ACTION_PARTIAL_TITLE: Recovery command completed with remaining failures
ISSUE_ACTION_COMPLETED_DESCRIPTION: The source completed the command and reported {{count}} failed target(s).
ISSUE_ACTION_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: The source completed the command, but {{count}} target(s) still need recovery.
DOMAIN_RECOVERY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Ownership verification is available only for unverified custom domains.
DOMAIN_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTION: Ownership verification ran for {{hostname}}. Review the evidence before treating the certificate as ready.
STORAGE_TEST_PASSED_DESCRIPTION: The storage owner confirmed the requested readiness test.
STORAGE_TEST_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The storage owner completed the test and reported a failure. Delivery readiness is not confirmed.
POLICY_CURRENT_DESCRIPTION: Changes are revision-bound and require an impact preview before they can be applied.
POLICY_WINDOW_NOT_CONFIGURED: No continuity window is currently active.
POLICY_WINDOW_HELP: This affects future Hosting Continuity transitions; it does not change a current source condition.
POLICY_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The preview records the expected revision and the affected active transitions. It does not apply the change.
POLICY_PREVIEW_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: Review the affected transitions before applying this policy revision.
POLICY_REASON_HELP: This reason is retained with the audited policy application.
POLICY_APPLIED_DESCRIPTION: Revision {{revision}} now uses a {{seconds}}-second continuity window for {{count}} affected active transition(s).
POLICY_APPLY_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: The policy operation reports partial failure. Review current delivery issues before assuming all transitions have converged.
RULES_EMPTY: No Hosting Continuity or delivery suspension projections are currently recorded.
POLICY_WINDOW_REQUIRED: Enter a whole-number continuity window of at least one second.
POLICY_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason before applying the reviewed policy.
ACTION_PERMISSION_TITLE: You no longer have permission for this action
ACTION_PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Refresh your Platform access before attempting another command.
ACTION_CONFLICT_TITLE: This change needs a new review
ACTION_CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: The source state changed after this view was loaded. Refresh and create a new preview before applying again.
ACTION_FAILED_TITLE: The command could not be completed
ACTION_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: No success was assumed. Review the diagnostic code and current source evidence before trying again.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no persisted records for this view.
ERROR_TITLE: Delivery records could not be loaded
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: The Platform Console did not replace real delivery facts with sample data.
